source_caption_text:
Happy 26th birthday to Baby Keem! 🎂🔥 

Never forget when he hit that flow state performing “family ties” and Kendrick came in with the adlibs 😭 The energy between those two was different 💯

Released in 2021, “family ties” peaked at No. 18 on the Billboard Hot 100 and earned Keem his first Grammy, winning Best Rap Performance alongside Kendrick Lamar in 2022 🏆 

That same era brought us his debut studio album, “The Melodic Blue,” which debuted at No. 5 on the Billboard 200 with approximately 53,000 equivalent album units in its opening week. From the energy of “family ties” to songs like “issues” and “16,” the project gave listeners several different sides of Keem 🎧🔥
